logistics.format: Multiple-choice (CEH) plus optional 6-hour CEH Practical lab

formal: EC-Council training OR 2 years documented infosec experience

minus.note: Base CEH is multiple-choice; only the optional CEH Practical is hands-on.

evaluation.rationale: Independent reviews of the stored evidence produced associate: 3. The ordered median is associate. See each persona rationale for the supporting factors and limitations.

hiroshi-tanaka.rationale: Japanese availability, accreditation and broad tool coverage support associate offensive knowledge; the base exam is multiple-choice and the optional practical cannot substantiate every holder's hands-on competence.

maria-okonkwo.rationale: Recorded DoD recognition and accreditation make CEH a useful associate screening credential for contract hiring. The base exam is multiple-choice, so its optional practical cannot be credited as mandatory evidence of pentest execution.

alex-novak.rationale: The recorded broad offensive tool coverage supports associate knowledge, with accreditation adding exam credibility. The practical exam is optional, so it cannot be credited to base CEH; mixed peer reputation and multiple-choice assessment limit the tier.
